name: Array r(m,n) = least k such that H(m) + H(n) - H(m*n + k) < g, where H denotes harmonic number and g denotes the Euler-Mascheroni constant.
comment: Since log(m*n) = log m + log n and log n is "close to" H(n) - g, this array indicates the "closeness" of H(m*n) to H(m) + H(n). Conjectures:
link: Clark Kimberling, Table of n, a(n) for n = 1..1830
mathematica: h[n_] := h[n] = HarmonicNumber[n]; z = 20; r[m_, n_] := Module[{Nn = N[n, 50], Nm = N[m, 50]}, NestWhile[# + 1 &, Floor[(m + n)/2], ! h[Nm] + h[Nn] - h[Nm*Nn + #] < EulerGamma &]]; Table[r[m, n], {m, z}, {n, z}] // TableForm  (* array *)
Flatten[Table[r[n - k + 1, k], {n, z}, {k, n, 1, -1}]]  (* sequence *)
author: _Clark Kimberling_, Jul 17 2013
